name: PhotoCraft native iPad port
stack: Rust, egui/eframe, wgpu/Metal, Python packaging, Xcode SDK, GitHub Actions
status: experimental preview; device IPA built and Simulator startup verified; physical iPad untested
description: Native iPadOS 17+ fork of PhotoCraft 0.16.0 with Metal rendering, sandboxed Files access and manual public cloud Mac builds. An unsigned ARM64 IPA is available for personal Windows signing; the app passed an iPad Simulator startup check.
